items.summary: Firecrawl is now available on the Vercel Marketplace , allowing Vercel teams to power AI agents and applications with structured web data without managing crawling infrastructure. items.title: Microfrontends routing now applies to vc alias and branch domains
items.summary: This week we are gradually rolling out an update to Vercel Microfrontends routing for aliases and branch-assigned domains. Aliases inherit Microfrontends routing Aliasing a Microfrontends URL with vc alias now preserves the full microfrontends routing config from the source deployment. Previously, the new alias only inherited the deploymentId . Update to the latest Vercel CLI to pick up the change. Branch domains route across all projects A project domain assigned to a git branch now routes to that branch in every project in the Microfrontend that shares the branch name. Previously, the domain only routed to that branch within the project that owned the domain. See the Microfrontends documentation for details on routing, aliases, and domain assignment. Read more

items.titleJa: フロントエンドもアーキテクチャに向き合う！
items.summaryJa: 社内システムのフロントエンドを、ドメインごとに責務を分けた段階的なアーキテクチャ移行を行った経緯をまとめた。フェーズ1で features/{domain} と repository を導入して、外部依存をドメイン層から切り離しテスト性を高め、フェーズ2で domains と models を分離してルールと UI 表現を分離。フェーズ3で infrastructure を導入しライブラリ依存を共通化、呼び出し側の実装を隠蔽。フェーズ4で core を導入し、複数文脈で共有される最内側の概念を src/core に集約して型変換を一本化した。結果、ビジネスロジックと UI 依存が分離され、テストしやすさと変更容易性が向上した。
